hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'gh +(secret|variable) +(set|delete)' || { printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qi 'gh api' && printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE 'secrets|variables' && printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(-X|--method)[ =]*(DELETE|PATCH|PUT|POST)|(^| )-(f|F) |--field|--raw-field|--input'; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by repo policy: modifying/deleting GitHub secrets and variables is not allowed"}}'; fi

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); REMOTE=0; URLS=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -oiE "postgres(ql)?://[^[:space:]\"']+" || true); if [ -n "$URLS" ] && printf '%s\n' "$URLS" | grep -viE '^postgres(ql)?://([^@/]*@)?(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)' | grep -q .; then REMOTE=1; fi; if printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(^|[[:space:];|&])(psql|pgcli)\b' && printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(^|[[:space:]])(-h|--host)[ =]' && ! printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE '(^|[[:space:]])(-h|--host)[ =]+(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)'; then REMOTE=1; fi; if [ "$REMOTE" = 1 ] && printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qiE '\b(insert|update|delete|drop|alter|create|truncate|grant|revoke|merge|vacuum|reindex|cluster|refresh)\b|\bcopy\b.*\bfrom\b|(^|[[:space:]])-f[[:space:]]|--file|(^|[^<])<($|[^<])'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by repo policy: never WRITE to a remote database (no DDL/DML/migrations, no executing .sql files). Read-only SELECT is fine. For changes, prepare a .sql file - a developer applies it manually via pgAdmin."}}'; fi
